caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers, colored in brown tones with darker shading to indicate depth and dimension. The chest has three horizontal tiers; the top and bottom tiers each contain four small drawers with brass lion-head ring handles, arranged in two rows. The middle tier consists of one large open compartment. All the drawers feature decorative rectangular panels and brass hardware. The top edge of the chest has an ornamental, curved wooden design. To the left of the chest, there is a simple line drawing of a lion’s head with a ring in its mouth, resembling the drawer handles. The drawing is centered on a cream background and enclosed within a thin rectangular border. In the bottom right corner, the text "Carl Keksi" is printed.
title: Butler's Table
